body:
emma: Quick design sync — proposing an "onboarding concierge" modal that appears on first org login. It's a centered modal with a 4-item checklist on the left and a sample-projects grid on the right. Modal is dismissible, can be reopened from Help > Onboarding. Thoughts?
ryan: I like the duel-column approach. Concern: focus trap behaviour — modal must trap focus but allow Escape to close and restore focus to the original trigger. Also ensure we persist a 'seen' flag per-user, per-org.
priya: Accessibility: add a visible focus outline, `aria-modal=true`, and role=dialog plus a descriptive aria-label. When a checklist item completes update an `aria-live` region (polite) with progress like "2 of 4 steps complete". Also add reduced-motion preference for the sample grid transitions.
ben: Copy thoughts: header variants: A) "Get set up — 4 quick steps" B) "Welcome — start your first project" C) "Ready in minutes: follow these quick steps"  which tone aligns? My vote: B (friendly).
emma: B feels warmer. We'll A/B test phrasing. Also UX decision: should the sample grid pre-filter by industry (web app, CLI, embeddings)? I think yes, default to 'general' but allow one-click filters.
priya: Keyboard nav inside the grid is important — arrow keys should move between cards, Enter opens the quick-run modal, Space toggles selection. Cards need accessible labels and non-color states for selection.
aria-bot: Experiment registered: concierge_modal_copy_B vs concierge_modal_copy_A. Metrics: concierge_shown, concierge_start_cta, concierge_sample_run, concierge_finished.
ryan: Analytics detail: fire `concierge_impression` (with experiment id), `concierge_step_completed` (step_id, user_id hashed), and `concierge_dismissed` with dismiss_type (soft/never). Respect privacy — send only hashed ids and avoid storing examples of user prompts.
ben: Admin controls: org admins should be able to disable the modal, or set it as mandatory for new members. Also add a small "Show me this again" link in user settings.
emma: Motion/accessibility note: add `prefers-reduced-motion` rules and a 'Minimize animations' toggle inside the modal for users who want simpler experience.
priya: Another a11y nit: ensure contrast >=4.5 for small text on cards, provide 48px minimum touch targets, and ensure the close control is reachable and has aria-label="Close onboarding concierge".
ryan: Mobile behaviour: modal becomes full-screen sheet; grid collapses to a vertical list with bigger CTAs. Ensure swipe-down to dismiss works and is discoverable.
aria-bot: Quick playtest scheduled: 6 participants on Tuesday 11am. Tasks: open modal, run sample app, dismiss and reopen from Help. Capture task completion + verbal feedback.
emma: I'll update the Figma file with new focus states, hashed-ids for analytics spec, and copy B frames. Posting in #design by EOD and sharing the playtest script. Thanks all! :sparkles:
